name: sim_geometry_bbd_decomposition_theorem_constraint_canonical
description: BBD decomposition theorem: Rf_* IC(X) ≅ ⊕ IC(Y_i)[n_i]; cvc5 load-bearing semisimplicity proof

pytorch.reason: pytorch not needed; pure symbolic/algebraic computation via cvc5 and sympy

pyg.reason: PyG message passing not needed; constraint geometry handled via SMT solver

z3.reason: z3 not needed; cvc5 handles all SMT constraint proofs in this sim

cvc5.reason: cvc5 SMT solver: load_bearing proof of BBD semisimplicity constraint

sympy.reason: sympy: supportive symbolic algebra for cohomology and Poincaré polynomials

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed; sheaf-theoretic constraints only

geomstats.reason: geomstats not needed; constraints handled via SMT solver

e3nn.reason: e3nn not needed; no SO(3) equivariance required

rustworkx.reason: rustworkx not needed; no graph structure in this sim

xgi.reason: xgi not needed; pairwise interactions only

toponetx.reason: toponetx not needed; standard algebraic ops sufficient

gudhi.reason: gudhi not needed; no persistent homology in this sim

sympy_positive_poincare_polynomial.test: Poincaré polynomial of direct sum IC decomposition
sympy_positive_poincare_polynomial.interpretation: BBD decomposition yields direct sum with additive Poincaré polynomial

cvc5_positive_semisimplicity_rank.test: cvc5 satisfies: rank(Rf_* IC) = Σ rank(IC(Y_i)) (semisimplicity)
cvc5_positive_semisimplicity_rank.interpretation: BBD decomposition semisimplicity constraint is satisfiable

numpy_positive_bbd_direct_sum.test: BBD decomposition: direct sum of IC sheaves
numpy_positive_bbd_direct_sum.interpretation: direct sum structure is consistent across strata

cvc5_negative_semisimplicity_violated.test: cvc5 proves UNSAT: rank mismatch violates BBD semisimplicity

sympy_negative_non_semisimple.interpretation: non-semisimple objects cannot satisfy BBD decomposition

numpy_negative_bbd_impossible.test: Impossible BBD decompositions excluded by semisimplicity
numpy_negative_bbd_impossible.interpretation: semisimplicity constraint filters out non-decomposable objects

sympy_boundary_trivial_decomposition.test: Boundary: trivial BBD decomposition (single IC sheaf)
sympy_boundary_trivial_decomposition.interpretation: single component is a valid (degenerate) BBD decomposition

cvc5_boundary_single_component.test: Boundary: CVC5 verifies single component decomposition

numpy_boundary_component_count_sweep.test: Boundary: component count sweep for BBD decomposition
